audience: businesses that run clients, jobcards and invoices in Invoices Online

useCases.title: Check client balances
useCases.text: List the clients with their balance and opening balance. Open one to read its contact details and current balance.

useCases.title: Review a client's invoices and payments
useCases.text: Find the client id from the name and email, then read the invoices, payments and balance history of that client.

useCases.title: Track jobcard status
useCases.text: List the status names for a document type, then read the current status of one jobcard by its number.

useCases.title: Look up suppliers and inventory
useCases.text: List the suppliers with their balances, and the inventory items with their product codes.

useCases.title: Add a new client
useCases.text: Create a client with a name and an email. If a matching client exists, the API returns its id and adds no duplicate. No email is sent.
